submission.justification: S1 has the highest nominal significance (about 4.1-4.2) but fails the hard validation constraint. Its data/MC mismodelling is 35%, against a 10% limit. S2 passes at 3% but its best significance is only 2.6. S3 passes at 6% and has the highest significance of the eligible options. Its scan peaks near 50-65% efficiency (about 3.4-3.5). The tool output is noisy: repeat runs differ by about 0.1-0.3. The 65% rerun gave 3.245, and the 55% rerun gave 3.554 against 3.406 on the first run. The 55% and 65% points are therefore statistically indistinguishable. I chose 55%, which sits in the middle of the plateau. Its mean significance is about 3.48, and it is well inside the 20-80% efficiency window. The mismodelling does not depend on the working point (6%).
